Softly sculpted rounded silhouettes, warm cream/sage/muted terracotta palette, matte non-plastic materials, broad restrained detail, neutral diffuse lighting, no cast shadows painted into textures, no background scene, no cats. Match docs/design/paws-style-reference.png art direction.
